subject: Initiate QuietBay vendor questionnaire — SOC 2 snapshot & form selection
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@quietbay.com>, Evan Li <evan.li@quietbay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initiate QuietBay vendor questionnaire — SOC 2 snapshot & form selection

Hi Marta / Evan,

Great speaking with you this morning — thanks for the time. Per our discovery call, QuietBay is moving forward with a security intake and we want to get the vendor questionnaire started so your security team can assess technical controls and compliance posture. To keep things efficient, we wanted to offer two paths and get your preference:

Options:
- CAIQ (consensus CAIQ) — we can prefill most answers and share supporting artifacts.
- Custom questionnaire — if you have a proprietary form, we can complete that instead.

Quick clarifying asks so we can scope the work:
- Which form do you prefer (CAIQ vs custom)?
- Do you need a redacted SOC 2 Type II report or only the SOC 2 summary? If SOC 2, which date range is acceptable?
- Any HIPAA / GDPR specifics to call out (BAA requirement, EU data residency, etc.)?
- Preferred evidence delivery: shared Drive folder, secure upload link, or email attachments?

Attached: QuietBay_SOC2_Summary.pdf (SOC 2 snapshot), CAIQ-prefill-template.xlsx (our prefilling template).

Proposed timeline: we can deliver a CAIQ prefill within 3 business days once you confirm, or complete a custom form within 5 business days. If you have a target deadline please share and we’ll prioritize.

Next steps (suggested):
1) You confirm form preference and deadline.
2) We send a Drive folder and prefill the CAIQ (if selected).
3) QuietBay uploads any required evidence.

Thanks — copying Camila and Soojin who will own evidence collection and technical clarifications.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: QuietBay_SOC2_Summary.pdf (pdf), CAIQ-prefill-template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Marta Alvarez <marta@quietbay.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Li <evan.li@quietbay.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initiate QuietBay vendor questionnaire — SOC 2 snapshot & form selection

Thanks Rafael — good recap. QuietBay prefers the CAIQ route to start (our security team finds the standard mapping faster). A few items from our side:

- We will need at minimum a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (covering the most recent 12 months). If you can provide the summary plus the Type II redacted report, that’s ideal.
- We have HIPAA-covered data in one product line; a BAA is required for any service that processes PHI. Can you confirm Redwood’s stance on BAAs?
- GDPR: we need confirmation of data processing locations and whether Redwood acts as a processor or sub-processor.

Preferred delivery: shared Drive folder (our security team will upload evidence there).

Can you also include a short system diagram (network + data flows) so our reviewers can map controls to your architecture?

Target deadline: we’re aiming to complete vendor risk review by 2027-09-21. If you could get the prefills + SOC 2 redaction to us by 2027-09-14 that would keep us on track.

Thanks — copying Evan who will take lead on the technical review.

Best,
Marta Alvarez
Head of Risk & Compliance | QuietBay
marta@quietbay.com
+1 (202) 555-0821
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@quietbay.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Li <evan.li@quietbay.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initiate QuietBay vendor questionnaire — SOC 2 snapshot & form selection

Hi Marta — thanks for the details and the target dates. Quick answers and a proposed plan from our side: 

Answers:
- SOC 2: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II (most recent report, period ending 2027-06-30) and the one-page SOC 2 Summary (attached previously).
- BAA: Redwood supports BAAs for customers handling PHI. We can share a standard BAA template and escalate to Legal if you need edits.
- GDPR / residency: Redwood is a processor for hosted API usage; we offer region pinning on Dedicated/Private options. I’ll include a plain-language data residency note in the Drive.

Proposed actions (mutual action plan):
- Today (2027-09-07): We create a shared Drive folder and upload the redacted SOC 2 Type II + prefills.
- 2027-09-09: QuietBay to review CAIQ prefill and flag any controls needing follow-up.
- 2027-09-14: Final supporting evidence uploaded by Redwood; QuietBay to complete review by 2027-09-21.

Deliverables we’ll upload: CAIQ-prefill-template.xlsx (prefilled answers), network-dataflow-diagram.png (system diagram), Redwood_BAA_template.pdf (BAA).

A couple of clarifying questions for Evan so we scope evidence correctly: 
- Do you need proof of encryption-at-rest for logs and backups, or only service data?
- For HIPAA scope, which product/team handles PHI — can you confirm the full hostname list or customer-facing product names?

If you confirm CAIQ, I’ll start prefilling and share the Drive link by end of day.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Security Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
From: Evan Li <evan.li@quietbay.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Alvarez <marta@quietbay.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initiate QuietBay vendor questionnaire — SOC 2 snapshot & form selection

Thanks Camila — CAIQ is fine. A few follow-ups from the QuietBay technical review perspective:

- Encryption: please include evidence for encryption-at-rest for customer data and backups. Point us to the KMS provider and whether keys are customer-managed in Dedicated offerings.
- HIPAA scope: PHI is limited to QuietBay Health product (api.health.quietbay.com and related storage buckets). We will provide a short list of the hostnames in a follow-up email.
- SOC2 redaction: redacted Type II is acceptable; ensure any customer identifiers are removed.
- Drive: we’ll accept the Drive link and will upload our intake form if needed — please grant Evan and Marta editor access.

Deadline: 2027-09-14 is ideal. If you can get the prefills and SOC artifacts in that window, we’ll proceed with review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Evan Li
Senior Security Engineer | QuietBay
evan.li@quietbay.com
